name: Death Cap
summary: In Darkshore, Death Cap grows in a cave behind Cliffspring Falls. Night elf herbalists seek the scarce fungus, though the Grove of the Ancients warns against going near the falls.

sections.title: A Toxic Bloom in the Dark
sections.body: Death Cap grows in a damp cave behind Cliffspring Falls, along Darkshore’s northeastern mountain ridges. Scaber stalks cover the cavern floor, but Death Cap is scarce. Night elf herbalists such as Barithras Moonshade value it for experimental brewing. To find even one, you must enter a cave the Grove of the Ancients warns against, where corruption is taking root.

sections.title: Omen of Cliffspring
sections.body: Guardians of the Grove of the Ancients warned local Kaldorei to stay away from Cliffspring Falls. They sensed a foul presence taking root in the darkness. Anyone who enters the cave for Death Cap must face whatever forces have claimed the damp hollow as their lair.

faq.q: Where can I find a Death Cap?
faq.answer: Death Cap grows in a hidden cave behind Cliffspring Falls, against the mountain wall in northeastern Darkshore.
Barithras Moonshade, an alchemist in Auberdine, the coastal settlement, seeks Death Cap for a specialized potion.

faq.q: Why didn't Barithras Moonshade collect it himself?
faq.answer: Guardians from the Grove of the Ancients warned Barithras to avoid the cave behind Cliffspring Falls. They sensed an encroaching evil there.

faq.q: How does the Death Cap differ from a Scaber Stalk?
faq.answer: Scaber stalks are plentiful across the floor of the Cliffspring cave, while Death Cap is scarce and harder to find.

angles.text: Gathering Death Cap for Barithras calls for no special sickle. Herbalists know the danger of seeking rare fungi in damp, corrupted caves.
As a night elf, you can bring Death Cap to Barithras in Auberdine and heed the Grove of the Ancients’ warning.
